row.proto: void Hud_MfdRow_BaseInit(void *row, void *list_handle, uint8_t vehicle, const char *name)
row.notes: Base init of an MFD settings row: gets or makes the child djb2(name) of the list node [list_handle+8], moves it into row+0x10 with its enabled (row+0x30) and visible (row+0x50) bools, then sets up the row's input binding object at row+0x68 (action_player_index, use_look_controls_ref) from row+0xa8 / row+0xb0. The vehicle argument (r8) is never read: callers store row+0xd0 themselves. 9 callers.

verify.notes: gh:serve-verify Confirmed: rcx = row, rdx = list handle (node [rdx+8]), r9 = name (djb2 into Vm_GetOrCreate_ChildNode; a null name skips it); 0x141785900 builds the node, enabled and visible handles that move into row+0x10, +0x30, +0x50; then 0x141785a80 (a jmp to the protector-relocated body 0x14b7ed680) sets action_player_index from row+0xa8 on the binding at row+0x68. Differences: r8 (vehicle) is never read by BaseInit, callers store row+0xd0 themselves; 9 callers (also 0x141785efd, 0x141787d68, 0x14178a4e6, 0x1417904b6, 0x141793402); the use_look_controls_ref source (row+0xb0) is not confirmed in the relocated body.
